1937, February
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 170 Feb. 22 Marcella Thompson - 15 - Epileptic
Robert Thompson her Br. - 23 worried about same his sister - Mother died and house burned these last few years, etc.
23 LaVern Fadell - 8 - Jewish - dumb Gowenlock - Irene - St. Louis - 3 rd operation ..??... H. Jacobs & Jewish dumb Girl Mrs. Stilwell - about foot trouble and financial "Every-body's Tabernacle" Wilfred Emery - 13 - deaf for 5 yrs. - from mumps ... from vomiting. 24 Mrs. Dederich - 45 - inward goiter Mrs. Anna Sheher - 60 - fears blind.
Page 171 Feb. 25th Mrs. Ellen Smith - 26 - Stroke - Operation about a year ago - Anxious with husband to get well - only recently had stroke - now just able to see but not to speak
Rt. Rev. Msgr F.L. Hultgen - 73 - Heart - of Tiffin, 0. Henry Ford ... "Poor man" .... "ruination of Souls working on Sundays" 1937, March
March
Mar. 1 Mrs. D. Silver - close to 50 - married out of Church .... marriage failure - later mar'd a Jew - Once a very beautiful person. . a few yrs. ago started drinking ... now in Eloise ... Pray for her.
1 Mrs. Jolly - 38 - has husband and three small children; baby 6 mo .- erycipilis .... one other with scarlet fever.
2 Florence Debeaussaert - 14 - operation apend. - revovery slow - En- rolled To-day ....
2 Jerome Sullivan case ... Enrolled Feb. 25 ( last Sunday) ... phone "Miracle"
Mrs. McNamara - 60 - threatening lump on breast - intending to go to Mayo Brs. tomorrow Enrolls To-day and starts her promise of 2.00 per month for year for Poor Souls.
